title: A Clean, New Heart
traveler_why: Willow the Warm is the Traveler who knows that a warm hug follows a true sorry, and tonight David asks for a clean heart: Willow grabs her brother’s toy, feels yucky inside, gives it back with an “I’m sorry,” and her heart feels clean and light again.
traveler_about: Willow fits tonight because she knows the gift of saying sorry and being forgiven. In Willow’s world today: Willow grabbed a toy from her brother and made him cry, and her tummy felt yucky. She took a breath, gave the toy back, and said, “I’m sorry.” Right away her heart felt clean and light again, and they hugged. Just like the psalm asks Heavenly Father for a clean heart, Willow found that saying sorry brings a happy fresh start.
